sources.summary: This document is a formal **mathematics assessment** for the **National Certificate (Vocational)** at **NQF Level 2**, issued by the South African Department of Higher Education and Training. The test evaluates students on three core mathematical pillars: **analytical geometry** involving coordinate planes and transformations, **spatial measurement** focusing on the volume and surface area of geometric solids, and **right-angled trigonometry**. Students are provided with a comprehensive **formula sheet** to assist in solving problems that range from calculating gradients to determining trigonometric ratios and statistical values. Ultimately, this structured examination serves to verify a learner's **foundational competency** in practical and theoretical math within a controlled vocational academic setting.

title: NC(V) Fundamentals Mathematics NQF Level 2 Task 6
